source: Owner (Taren), chat 2026-11-10: the kitchen image library variable list, and answers to the follow-up questions the same day. Peninsula and double island are kept from the intake (owner, 2026-11-10). Items marked "proposed" are this session's suggestions, not owner decisions.
purpose: Every option the image selector shows, with what each photorealistic image must change. Each step's images vary one thing on the default kitchen; everything else stays as the default. Images are AI edits of one locked base photo per room shape, masked to one region, anchored to an owner-approved real reference photo, and checked automatically before they are kept.

rules.text: Island options show only for room shapes with an island (owner, 2026-11-10). Peninsula does not get them (IK-18).
Slab handleless doors skip every handle step.

The colours offered come from the chosen material's list: Tafisa → Tafisa TFL colours; painted → Sherwin-Williams paint colours; any wood species → stains. Wood species and stain are separate picks, and stains apply to every species (owner, 2026-11-10).
Vertical or horizontal applies to handles on doors. Single or double, and centred or top-aligned, apply to whatever is on the drawers.
Lengths 5 1/2", 8" and 12" apply to handles only (owner, 2026-11-10).
The "matching doors" island back uses the client's chosen door style (owner, 2026-11-10), so it has one image per door style.
A waterfall end uses the chosen counter, so it has one image per counter pattern and colour.
Counter colours are shown in the chosen pattern, so the counter step has one image per pattern and colour (PROPOSED).

Every image is anchored to a real-life reference photo of the door style, material, finish colour or product, found by the tool and approved by the owner before generation, never a guess from words (owner, 2026-11-10).
